caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent wine glass with a broad bowl, a short stem with two rounded decorative elements, and a flat circular base. The wine glass is rendered in pencil or graphite, with shading used to indicate the transparency and reflective qualities of the glass material. The glass is centrally positioned within a rectangular border, also drawn in pencil, on a plain, light beige or off-white background. The artist's signature, "F. Umagalli," is located in the lower right corner within the bordered area. There are no additional objects or colors present in the drawing.
title: Wine Glass
